description:
SGP is seeking organized, detail-oriented Capture Coordinators to support capture managers and business development (BD) teams in researching, tracking, and coordinating federal contracting opportunities. You will support multiple pursuits, maintain capture-related information, and help ensure a smooth transition from capture to proposal development.

You'll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable supporting multiple clients, each with distinct pipelines, tools, and priorities. You'll also have experience collaborating with capture managers, proposal managers, proposal coordinators, writers, editors, graphic designers, and pricing professionals to keep capture activities organized and support an effective handoff to the proposal team.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $95 -$110 per hour.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you’ll retain the independence of contract work while accessing a collaborative network of resources to support successful engagements.

  • Select consultant network: Collaborate with experienced capture managers and gain exposure to capture planning, research, and strategic activities, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as your experience develops.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

  • A path to grow: Collaborate with experienced capture managers and gain exposure to capture planning, research, and strategic activities, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as your experience develops.

Responsibilities

  • Research federal contracting opportunities, agencies, incumbents, and competitors using public and subscription-based resources.

  • Enter and maintain pipeline data and opportunity records in each client's CRM or tracking tools, such as GovSignal, GovWin, or Salesforce, ensuring stages, dates, and supporting documents remain current.

  • Draft capture plan sections, call plans, competitor profiles, and gate review materials under the direction of the capture manager.

  • Conduct preliminary eligibility checks based on NAICS codes, size standards, set-aside classifications, and contract vehicle requirements.

  • Prepare RFI and sources sought response templates, capability statements, and compliance checklists for capture manager review.

  • Monitor SAM.gov, agency forecasts, and pipeline tools for sources sought notices, RFIs, draft RFPs, and amendments; summarize key updates for the capture team.

  • Coordinate teaming partner outreach and track nondisclosure agreements (NDAs), teaming agreements, and partner data calls.

  • Schedule capture meetings and document action items and decisions.

  • Organize capture materials to support an efficient handoff to the proposal team.

  • Maintain client capture libraries, including past performance summaries and capability narratives.

Required qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience supporting federal business development, capture, or proposal efforts.

  • Familiarity with SAM.gov and the federal acquisition process.

  • Strong research, organizational, and written communication skills.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of recurring tasks and deadlines.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with GovWin, GovSignal, HigherGov, GovTribe, Salesforce, or similar opportunity intelligence and CRM platforms.

  • Experience with industry-proven structured capture processes.

  • Experience supporting 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB, or other small business set-aside pursuits.

  • Experience supporting multiple concurrent federal pursuits or client engagements.
